description: This file implements a bulk client for Elasticsearch, providing methods for indexing, deleting, flushing, and stopping bulk operations, with support for time- and size-based thresholds.

classes.name: DataBulkClient
classes.description: A client for performing bulk operations on Elasticsearch, supporting time- and size-based thresholds.

methods.name: NewDataBulkClient
methods.description: Constructor for DataBulkClient, initializes the bulk indexer with provided settings.

methods.name: onSuccess
methods.description: Callback invoked when a bulk operation is successfully added.

methods.name: onFailure
methods.description: Callback invoked when a bulk operation fails to be added.

methods.name: IndexOp
methods.description: Adds an index operation to the bulk client.

methods.name: DeleteOp
methods.description: Adds a delete operation to the bulk client.

methods.name: _stop
methods.description: Closes the bulk indexer, flushing all pending operations.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Flushes the bulk indexer by closing and recreating it.
